actions.label: Add prompt.text from Node Library
actions.expected: The blank document creates prompt.text through the registry-backed factory.

actions.label: Add prompt.worker from Node Library
actions.expected: The blank document creates prompt.worker through the registry-backed factory.

actions.label: Select the workflow for a Module
actions.expected: The canvas-owned select-all command selects both blank-authored nodes before organization.

actions.label: Create Module from selection
actions.expected: The visible command moves the selection into one locked, durable Module through the shared graph command.

actions.label: Locked by default
actions.expected: New Modules protect their contents and position until explicitly unlocked.
actions.actual: The new Module replaced both parent nodes and reported data-module-locked=true.

actions.label: Capture locked Module creation
actions.expected: A blank-authored selection is visibly represented as Ether's single locked organizational container.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Try to move the locked Module
actions.expected: A locked Module remains fixed on the parent canvas.

actions.label: Select the Module
actions.expected: The Project lens switches to the Module inspector.

actions.label: Focus Module rename
actions.expected: F2 targets the selected Module title field.

actions.label: Choose the Module highlight
actions.expected: The Module uses a deliberate Violet accent.

actions.label: Save Module details
actions.expected: Title, description, and accent commit together.

actions.label: Explicitly unlock the Module
actions.expected: Parent-canvas movement and membership controls become available only after this action.

actions.label: Move the unlocked Module
actions.expected: The explicitly unlocked Module can be repositioned on the parent canvas.

actions.label: Restore Module selection
actions.expected: The moved Module remains the current organization target.

actions.label: Collapse the Module
actions.expected: Collapse compacts presentation without deleting its internal graph.

actions.label: Capture edited collapsed Module
actions.expected: The Module visibly carries its title, description, Violet highlight, unlocked state, and compact presentation.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Expand the Module
actions.expected: The full Module presentation returns with its durable metadata.

actions.label: Select Module for keyboard entry
actions.expected: Canvas focus can enter the selected Module through the primary edit shortcut.

actions.label: Enter the Module
actions.expected: Enter opens the Module's independently editable internal graph.

actions.label: Capture Module interior
actions.expected: Both original blank-authored members are visible inside the Module workspace.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Select one Module member
actions.expected: One internal member becomes the membership change target.

actions.label: Move a member to the parent
actions.expected: Unlocked membership editing moves the selected node out without recreating it.

actions.label: Leave the Module
actions.expected: The parent viewport and Module selection are restored.

actions.label: Select the parent node
actions.expected: The moved member is selected for reassignment.

actions.label: Add the Module to the selection context
actions.expected: Shift-click preserves the selected parent node while opening Module membership controls.

actions.label: Add the selected node to the Module
actions.expected: The existing node returns to the Module through the explicit membership command.

actions.label: Durable membership
actions.expected: Members move across the parent/Module boundary without duplicate identities or hidden leftovers.
actions.actual: The internal count changed 2 -> 1 -> 2 while the parent count changed 0 -> 1 -> 0.

actions.label: Relock the Module
actions.expected: The completed organization is protected again explicitly.

actions.label: Capture relocked membership
actions.expected: The two-member Module is visibly relocked after a complete membership round trip.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Unlock before dissolution
actions.expected: Dissolution remains a deliberate action unavailable while locked.

actions.label: Confirm Module dissolution
actions.expected: Dissolve restores both members to the parent in one undoable transaction.

actions.label: Capture dissolved Module
actions.expected: Both original members are restored to the parent canvas with no Module shell left behind.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Undo Module dissolution
actions.expected: Undo restores the Module and removes the restored parent copies atomically.

actions.label: Inspect the restored Module
actions.expected: Undo preserves the Module metadata and explicit lock state from immediately before dissolution.

actions.label: Relock the restored Module
actions.expected: The practical journey ends with the recovered organization protected.

actions.label: Capture dissolution undo
actions.expected: Undo visibly restores the named two-member Module, ready in its protected state.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.
